summary: Build incident playbooks, escalation control, and response reporting. Train your team to govern cyber incidents with confidence.
lede: Cyber resilience training helps incident response and security professionals coordinate governed action during cyber incidents. It is designed for incident response managers, governance leads, risk analysts, and operations teams who need to make decisions and document response under pressure. Participants practise incident triage and escalation, evidence handling, stakeholder reporting, and recovery coordination.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who need to govern cyber incidents, coordinate response actions, and produce defensible reporting when disruption, evidence preservation, and executive scrutiny arrive at the same time.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites for this intermediate course include working knowledge of cybersecurity operations, basic incident response concepts, and familiarity with security controls, logs, or escalation workflows. You should be comfortable reading incident reports and participating in response coordination, but you do not need programming experience. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises, and prior exposure to SIEM dashboards, case management tools, or GRC workflows will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
